department: Molecular and Cellular Biology Graduate Program

deadline.value: Application materials are due December 1 for the PhD beginning the following fall.
deadline.quote: December 1 is the deadline for the receipt of application materials for acceptance into the PhD program beginning the following fall.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores can be submitted but are not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores for the General Exam or Subject Tests can be submitted to supplement the application, but are not required.

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject scores can be submitted but are not required.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores for the General Exam or Subject Tests can be submitted to supplement the application, but are not required.

supervisor.value: First-semester PhD students do three lab rotations before choosing a group.
supervisor.quote: First semester PhD students undertake 3 rotations and are supported in the Fall with College fellowships.

funding.value: PhD students get a stipend (about $43,000 in 2026/27), health insurance and tuition waivers, and are supported for up to five years in good standing.
funding.quote: Doctoral degree students who remain in good standing will be supported for up to five years.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is required before the program starts; no master's is needed.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree from a qualified college or university is required or expected prior to the program's start date.

notes: Other UMass biology PhDs (Organismic and Evolutionary Biology, Microbiology, Plant Biology) are separate programs not saved here. Biomedicine is one of MCB's listed research areas.
